proc_p: A fitted home office usually takes four to six weeks to make after design sign-off.
steps: We measure the room and list your screens, files and equipment, and where every cable needs to go.
You see the desk, shelving and storage in 3D, with a quote that lists every piece.
Every piece is made to your room in our workshop, with cable routes built in.
We install the office ready to work in, covered by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Tell us how you work and what needs to fit in the room. We’ll visit, measure up and send a 3D design with an itemised quote.
